title.narrative: Operating the prosthetics and rehabilitation center in Aden Governorate

description.narrative: Providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following up on them and benefiting from them in community service, diagnosing and determining the treatment plan for each individual patient, installing all types of prosthetic limbs, providing functional rehabilitation services for prosthetic limbs and continuing their follow-up, raising the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically and preparing them to deal with specific cases, reducing Migration of specialized medical and technical personnel

Providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following up on them, benefiting from them in community service, diagnosis, determining the treatment plan for each individual patient, installing all types of prosthetic limbs, providing functional rehabilitation service for prosthetic limbs, continuing their follow-up, raising the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically, and preparing them to deal with specific cases. Reducing the migration of medical and technical personnel specialized in localizing and improving prosthetics and rehabilitation services, helping people with special needs by engaging them in social life, maintaining their continued performance within civil society elements, and raising the capabilities of workers at the prosthetics center with the latest medical sciences.

Providing the needs for the manufacture and installation of (500) new limbs and rehabilitation, follow-up, and repair supplies for (3,000) injured and sick people, providing the center’s services to (3,543) beneficiaries, and empowering (43) medical, technical, administrative, and auxiliary staff to occupy jobs at the center, and reducing the migration of specialized personnel and raising their capabilities.
